{{Quote|I am Lieutenant Phison. And I apologize for my haste, but I have to get some information and comm it to the bridge before we get you settled into quarters. Your emergency comm mentioned pirates.|Phison|<ref name="MK" />}}
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Phison''' was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] crewmember of [[Burst Fire-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel|''Burst Fire''-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel]] ''[[Concussor]]''.<ref name="MK" /> During one of ''Concussor''{{'s}} patrols in [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> they picked up an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] that contained [[Bhindi Drayson]] and her unit of [[Wraith Squadron]], who were on a mission to prove [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] of his guilt in the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]].<ref name="MK" />

Phison was enamored by Drayson's "air-headed heiress" act, which she used to get Phison to give her a tour of the ''Concussor'' so that the Wraiths could take over. When they succeeded in that operation, Phison and his crew were dropped off on a habitable [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of a distant [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with substantial provisions to live off.<ref name="MK" />
